verdict: offline implementation review passes for the exact bound sources; no blocking correctness findings
scope: Cold-source hydration candidate versus prefix-pair-binary saved Rust sources. No external RPC, credentials, live operations, source edits, snapshot edits, commits or pushes by reviewer.

contractReview.finding: The branch is inside source-pinned scalar strict_simulate, requires trial_prefix and self.pinned.is_none(), and accepts at most 253 hydration items plus exactly three source checks. Over-bound work selects the existing path before dispatch; no truncation or post-send fallback. Even a different-source existing session remains on the original path.

Combined replies pass unchanged pinned batch identity/type/completeness checks, then all three source checks and complete header/environment/root comparison. Only then is a new session constructed and hydration applied. Invalid-source or malformed/missing hydration cannot publish self.pinned, source attestation, deal hints or EVM effects.

RpcClient implementation is byte-identical to baseline. All response errors still pass through the fatal latch; an invalid source plus hydration quota error stays fatal and can report rpc-throttle, as accepted by the plan. Combined retry reissues the same whole body with existing limits. No fallback follows a dispatched failure. Success/no-retry logical-call equality does not imply equality on invalid prechecks or retries.
